sentences.en: The prince was confined in the castle for three years.
sentences.zh: 王子被关在城堡里三年。

sentences.en: I wonder if Prince William lets anyone call him Bill.
sentences.zh: 我想知道威廉王子是否允许别人叫他比尔。

sentences.en: Prince William is second in line to the English throne.
sentences.zh: 威廉王子是英国王位的第二顺位继承人。

senses.zh: 王子,巨头,（某些欧洲国家的）贵族,小国的君主
